name: Improved Soul Leech modifies Soul Leech Mana only, not Shadow Bolt or itself
contract: Improved Soul Leech rank 1 (54117) carries two maskless first-effect modifiers (+4 and +2, SPELLMOD_EFFECT1).
SpellAffect.dbc names their targets: Soul Leech Mana 59117 and 59118. Without that routing they reach every
Warlock spell, including the talent's own passive first effect, which recalculates from its own modifier on every
reapplication until it overflows: Shadow Bolt and Incinerate deal 0 and Immolate's periodic damage explodes.
With routing, Shadow Bolt (47809) keeps its first effect and Soul Leech Mana (59117) gains exactly +6.

steps.label: Baseline: Shadow Bolt's first effect is unmodified
Soul Leech Mana gains both first-effect modifiers (+4 +2)
Shadow Bolt's first effect is not modified by Improved Soul Leech
Learning rank 2 does not grow the modifier on Soul Leech Mana
Shadow Bolt is still unmodified after rank 2
